modifiedSource: Frozen clean commit recorded in provenance; only skill-scope catalog intervention.
intervention: T1: append bounded name/scope metadata from enabled configured skills to the immutable Light startup system prompt. Keep skill availability, full bodies, tool schemas, validation and recovery unchanged. Native Cline does not receive the new catalog.
taskSelection: Four newly authored cases, selected before their model outcomes and before the registered global panel begins. Canary partial outcomes already inspected. No case was used for intervention selection; all are confirmation of the unchanged T1 mechanism, with card-hierarchy an applicable-design scope control. This remains an internal, unblinded four-task corpus, not independent external certification.
transport: Configured BLAME API/openai-codex; no artificial interruption; auth values never archived
environment: Same Linux x64 worker and frozen runtime/dependencies as T1. Fresh identical minimal four-case fixture per trial, no memory or solution retrieval. Separate fixture/evaluator hashes. Uncontrolled provider/cache variation.

budget.policy: USD 0.05 per-trial SDK estimate guard and USD 0.30 observed-panel stop. Neither is an invoice cap. Separate from canary and global campaigns.

ordering: Unchanged driver: manifest order in repetition one; reversed task and arm order in repetition two. Arm rotation uses the full task index, so indices >=3 retain base arm order. Sequential, no replacement or outcome-driven stopping.
quality: Primary instruction criteria AND successful runtime completion, including observed post-edit agent build. All input/source audits retained. Behavioral evaluator covers allocation invariants and invalid inputs, revision identity/mutation, backoff cap/invalid inputs and preserved shouldRetry. Card checks exact declared CSS delivery values, not aesthetic superiority. Skill invocation is a mechanism/control observation, not a mandatory delivery criterion.
accounting: Observe input+output tokens as primary efficiency, with task-matched audited-completion AND usage-reconciled pairs, plus whole-panel success/failure resources. Cache tokens are subsets of input; reasoning is a subset of output; do not double count. Preserve timeouts and missing request/cache/provider usage. Report task-cluster paired uncertainty. Category bytes measure repeated context exposure, not billed tokens; native categories absent.
decision: Run all 24 planned trials irrespective of direction. Compare unchanged frozen three arms. Report this four-task corpus separately from the known 25-task global diagnostics; do not pool fixtures or select cases by results. No new runtime change.
